def is_prime(n):
    if n < 2:
        return False
    for i in range(2, int(n**0.5) + 1):
        if n % i == 0:
            return False
    return True

# Find prime pairs (p, q) such that p + q = 800 and p < q < 797
p_candidates = []
for p in range(3, 400): # p must be odd prime, p < 400
    if is_prime(p):
        q = 800 - p
        if is_prime(q) and p < q and q < 797:
            p_candidates.append((p, q))

print(p_candidates)

# Test the candidate triplets (p, q, 797)
r = 797
prime_sums_verified = []

for p, q in p_candidates:
    # Required sums:
    s1 = p + q - r
    s2 = q + r - p
    s3 = r + p - q
    s4 = p + q + r
    
    # Check primality of all four sums
    if all(is_prime(s) for s in [s1, s2, s3, s4]):
        prime_sums_verified.append((p, q, r))

print(prime_sums_verified)
